entries.proposition: The only WWOX content in this source is a Discussion citation of an intra-tandem chaperoning interpretation; the paper performs no WWOX experiment.
entries.snippet: the presence of one WW domain may have a chaperone activity for the other, promoting its folding, as in the case of WW domains of WWOX
entries.anchor: Discussion, Structure of PRPF40A tandem WW domains and proline-rich peptide recognition

entries.proposition: When the same intra-tandem chaperoning proposal was tested experimentally for this group's own protein, it failed: the second WW domain folds without the first.
entries.snippet: However, our data demonstrate that WW2 can be folded independently of WW1
entries.anchor: Discussion, Structure of PRPF40A tandem WW domains and proline-rich peptide recognition

entries.proposition: The field baseline this source states for an isolated WW domain binding a proline-rich peptide is hundreds of micromolar, which is the scale against which any WWOX WW affinity must be judged.
entries.snippet: The affinity of individual WW domains for proline-rich peptides is normally modest with a dissociation constant typically in the range of hundreds of micromolar
entries.anchor: Discussion, Intramolecular autoinhibition proofreads the binding selectivity of WW domains

entries.proposition: A published tandem-WW structure was shown to be wrong because it was built on a truncated construct, so construct boundaries decide what a domain-pair structure reports.
entries.snippet: a previously reported structure of the PRPF40A WW domain tandem
entries.anchor: Results, The WW domains of PRPF40A are folded independently and exhibit significant domain mobility

entries.proposition: The correction of that structure required two orthogonal solution techniques to agree, not one.
entries.snippet: we have validated our ensemble in contrast to the truncated published model
entries.anchor: Discussion, Structure of PRPF40A tandem WW domains and proline-rich peptide recognition

entries.proposition: Affinities were measured on purified protein by isothermal titration calorimetry under stated buffer and temperature conditions, at least in duplicate — the assay format absent from the WWOX enzymology chain.
entries.snippet: Experiments were conducted on a MicroCAl PEAQ-ITC (Malvern Instruments, UK) at 25

entries.proposition: A single peptide out of a systematic panel carried a hundred-fold affinity difference, so a motif called high-affinity by sequence inspection is not one until it is titrated.
entries.snippet: except in the case of the highest affinity peptide
entries.anchor: Results, PRPF40A recognizes a specific proline-rich motif in the SF1 C-terminal region

entries.proposition: The proposed regulatory mechanism was tested causally: mutating the two motifs restored the affinity the mechanism was said to suppress.
entries.snippet: This restored the binding affinity to be comparable to the isolated WW tandem
entries.anchor: Results, Intramolecular interactions provide specificity for WW domain peptide recognition

entries.proposition: The authors state their generalisation to other WW-tandem proteins as a hypothesis still to be tested, and WWOX is not among the proteins they list as candidates.
entries.snippet: Whether the internal proline-rich sequences that these proteins have, act in a similar way as in PRPF40A still needs further analysis
entries.anchor: Discussion, Intramolecular autoinhibition proofreads the binding selectivity of WW domains
